app.tagline: Internal operations for observability and security services
app.brandPlaceholder: Company name will come from configuration

home.title: How work flows
home.intro: Follow the path from customer to invoice. Open steps jump to the right screen.
home.openProjectsCue: Finance watches {{count}} open project(s) until they are billed and closed.

planning.title: Weekly planning
planning.intro: Customer engagements and unavailability for the week — separate from hour reporting.
planning.autoResolveHint: Planned kickoffs and unavailable blocks are treated as busy time: the kickoff session planner only offers free slots.

time.intro: Book hours on signed-contract projects and internal budgets. Edit until approved.
time.adminIntro: Approve hours, or refuse them so they become editable again.
time.pendingHint: All outstanding registrations, regardless of week.
time.correctionHint: Refuse returns approved hours to editable (selected week).

customer.title: Customers
customer.intro: Manage customers and MSPs, billing details, and child accounts billed through an MSP.
customer.name: Company name
customer.mspHint: MSP accounts are parents for end-customer child accounts.
customer.parentHint: When linked, activities on this customer are billed to the MSP.
customer.channelHint: Provide at least an email or a phone number.
customer.billingSameAsAddress: Billing address is the same as company address
customer.searchHint: Type to search by company name or primary contact.
customer.hasOpenProjects: This customer still has open projects and cannot be deleted.
customer.hasChildAccounts: This MSP still has child accounts and cannot be deleted.
customer.parentNotMsp: The selected parent must be an MSP.
customer.mspCannotHaveParent: An MSP cannot be a child account of another customer.
customer.projectServiceUnavailable: Project check is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.

budget.projectsIntro: Configure fixed price, reserves, and assignees from Resources. Advance the phase dial to In delivery for hour booking, then Delivered for finance.
budget.staffingHint: Pick people from Resources. Shares must add up to 100%. Rate defaults to the resource billable rate and can be overridden for this project.
budget.rateHint: Defaults from Resources; override only if this project differs.
budget.staffingResourceRequired: Each assignee must be a resource from the Resources list.
budget.duplicateStaffing: The same resource cannot be assigned twice.
budget.sharesMustSum: Assignee shares must add up to 100%.
budget.invalidRate: Enter a valid hourly rate greater than zero.
budget.progressCompleteHint: Complete moves the funnel to Finalizing and removes the project from hour reporting.
budget.reportHint: Link to the report delivered to the client (required for completion billing).

finance.title: Finance
finance.hubIntro: Open a section for the sales funnel, running projects, billing, costs, or KPI overview.
finance.funnelIntro: Projects sold but not yet invoiced. Open value and remaining hours that can still be scheduled. The monthly chart is historical sold value by creation month and does not drop when a project finishes.
finance.funnelEmpty: No sold projects in the pre-invoice backlog.
finance.funnelMonthlyIntro: Sold value booked in each month (by project creation). Stays as historical data after delivery/invoicing.
finance.operationalIntro: Open projects on the phase dial — hour booking while In delivery; Finance takes over from Delivered.
finance.billingIntro: Generate invoices for completed fixed-price work, 50% milestones (assignments above €30k), or unbilled consultancy hours.
finance.awaitingPaymentEmpty: No issued invoices waiting for payment.
finance.billingEmpty: No projects are ready to invoice. Mark a project Delivered on the phase dial, or approve billable hours on a delivered T&M project.
finance.buyerAddressMissing: Buyer address missing — update customer billing details.
finance.deleteInvoiceConfirm: Delete invoice {{number}}? This cannot be undone.
finance.overdueAlert: {{count}} invoice(s) overdue — follow up with the customer
finance.agendaEmpty: No invoices due this week and none overdue.
finance.internalIntro: Company reserve is net of VAT. VAT collected on invoices sits in a separate account until remitted every quarter.
finance.vatIntro: VAT on issued/paid invoices is held here and paid to the tax authority every 3 months.
finance.vatInputIntro: Personnel rates are ex-VAT. VAT on external personnel is paid on their invoices and reclaimable as input VAT against collected VAT.
finance.vatNetAfterInput: Net VAT due this quarter (after personnel input VAT €{{input}}): €{{eur}}
finance.compensationEmpty: No approved time entries in the finance ledger yet.
finance.compensationUndone: Compensation entry undone; hours reopened for editing.
finance.compensationInvoiced: Already on an invoice — undo blocked.
finance.hoursByResourceEmpty: No approved hours for this month yet.
finance.personnelProposalsIntro: Monthly draft invoices for external people: hours × internal rate, plus VAT. Sent as a proposal (PDF) with their address and your company as bill-to.
finance.personnelProposalsEmpty: No approved hours for external resources this month.
finance.personnelProposalExists: A factuurvoorstel for this person and month already exists.
finance.personnelNoHours: No approved hours for this person in the selected month.
finance.monthlyCostsIntro: Add one-off costs for a month, or recurring costs that apply every month from the start month (optional end).
finance.monthlyCostsEmpty: No costs apply to this month yet.
finance.costEndHint: Leave empty for ongoing recurring costs.
finance.costInvalid: Enter a label, amount (≥ 0), and start month.
finance.supplierIntro: Track invoices from external resources and other costs. Mark matched and paid when complete.
finance.kpiRecurringHint: Recurring costs count once per month in the period (×3 for a full quarter, ×12 for a full year).
finance.billedEmpty: Nothing billed in this period yet.
finance.costOverviewIntro: Personnel from approved hours; non-personnel from monthly costs accrued to date.
finance.costOverviewIntroPeriod: Personnel from approved hours in this period; non-personnel from one-off months plus recurring × months in the period.
finance.personnelExpectedHint: Approved hours × project/resource billable rate (ex VAT).
finance.personnelActualHint: Approved hours × internal rate (ex VAT) · chargebacks €{{chargeback}} included.
finance.personnelVatHint: Rates are ex-VAT. This VAT is payable on external invoices and fully reclaimable — it does not affect gross profit.
finance.nonPersonnelPeriodHint: Includes recurring costs × {{months}} for {{period}} (when active the whole period).

catalog.title: Service catalog
catalog.intro: Fixed-price offerings used when creating customer projects.
catalog.confirmDelete: Remove this offering from the catalog? Existing projects are not affected.
catalog.name: Name (EN)
catalog.invalidPrice: Enter a valid list price (€0 or more).
catalog.invalidHours: Enter typical hours greater than zero.
catalog.missingRequired: Service ID and name are required.

resources.title: Resources
resources.intro: Internal and external people for staffing, kickoff eligibility, and utilization.
resources.confirmDelete: Remove resource “{{name}}” from the active pool?
resources.name: Display name
resources.rateVatHint: Rates exclude VAT. For external resources, VAT is paid on their invoice and reclaimable as input VAT.
resources.billingHint: Shown as FROM on monthly factuurvoorstellen. Bill-to is your company profile.
resources.invalidRates: Enter a valid billable rate (> 0) and internal rate (≥ 0).

project.pageIntro: Running projects: phase dial, kickoff, assignees, and reserves. Closed projects are hidden here.
project.runningEmpty: No running projects yet. Create one to get started.
project.createIntro: Pick a billable customer and a catalog offering. VAT, billing address, and contact details are required on the customer.
project.customerSearchHint: Type part of the company or contact name…
project.created: Project created at Ordered. Advance the dial to In delivery before booking hours.
project.kickoffHint: Optional manual date. Prefer Plan kickoff to book a 1h slot with a senior.
project.invalidFunnelTransition: That stage change is not allowed from the current stage.

agenda.weekIntro: Kickoffs, unavailability, and invoice due dates for the selected week.
agenda.pickerIntro: Free 1h slots with senior engineers (Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, Europe/Amsterdam).
agenda.pickerBusyHint: Slots that overlap a planned customer engagement or unavailability are excluded automatically.
agenda.noSlots: No free senior slots in the next two weeks.
agenda.bookedWithHours: Kickoff booked {{when}} with {{who}}. 1 paid hour registered and approved.
agenda.kickoffHoursFailed: Appointment saved, but hour registration failed: {{detail}}
agenda.kickoffHoursMissingPartner: Senior has no linked partner id.
agenda.slotUnavailable: That slot overlaps existing calendar time.
agenda.alreadyBooked: This project already has a kickoff booked.
agenda.slotInPast: Cannot book a slot in the past.
agenda.noSeniors: No active senior resources to assign.
agenda.endsRequired: Pick a from and to date/time.
agenda.notAllowed: You cannot plan or cancel this calendar entry.
agenda.rangeTooLarge: Unavailability cannot span more than 90 days.
agenda.resourceCalendarIntro: Outside business hours is unavailable by default. Mark one-time unavailability with a from–to range when someone is out during the day.
agenda.resourceCalendarEmpty: Nothing planned on resource calendars this week.
agenda.projectAgendaIntro: Upcoming kickoffs and related calendar entries for a project (next 90 days).
agenda.projectAgendaHint: Select a project to see planned dates.
agenda.projectAgendaEmpty: No upcoming planned dates for this project.
agenda.planBlockIntro: Book a one-time unavailable block with a from and to date/time. This blocks kickoff scheduling for that resource.
agenda.rangeHint: Use any continuous from–to range (hours, days, or up to 90 days).
